section: Educational Psychology · Ch13 — Assessment: Reliability & Tools (Complete)
subject: Educational Psychology
stem: After completing an essay, students exchange papers with a classmate and use a checklist to give each other feedback on organisation, grammar, and argument, before submitting a final version to the teacher. This assessment technique is called:
explanation: Peer assessment has students evaluate each other's work using clear criteria, building critical thinking and giving/receiving constructive feedback — a common CCE (continuous and comprehensive evaluation) technique.

stem: Before submitting a project, a student uses a checklist to reflect on and rate their own work against the given criteria, identifying their own strengths and areas needing improvement. This assessment technique is called:
explanation: Self-assessment has students reflect on and evaluate their own work against set criteria, building metacognitive awareness and ownership of learning — a key CCE technique distinct from peer assessment (evaluating others' work).
